sanskrit_verse: भैक्षाग्निकार्ये त्यक्त्वा तु सप्तरात्रम् अनातुरः । कामावकीर्ण इति आभ्यां जुहुयाद् आहुतिद्वयम् ॥
transliteration: bhaikṣāgnikārye tyaktvā tu saptarātram anāturaḥ / kāmāvakīrṇa ity ābhyāṃ juhuyād āhutidvayam //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who abandons the duties of begging and fire maintenance for seven nights without illness shall offer two oblations with the mantra 'kāmāvakīrṇa' to restore alignment with dharmic conduct.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from sustained dharmic practice, not mere birth or title.
Causation arises through conscious omission of prescribed duty.
Capacity-based responsibility requires restoration of ritual and social function.
Restoration logic operates through symbolic completion and energetic purification.
Consciousness alignment occurs via intentional rectification of disrupted patterns.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent_abandons_duty(bhaikṣa OR agni) AND duration > 7 nights AND health_status = stable THEN execute_ritual_rectification(āhuti × 2, mantra = kāmāvakīrṇa)
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that failure in foundational dharmic observances creates a jurisdictional threshold requiring ritual restitution prior to reintegration into religious or judicial authority. The court must verify both the factual lapse and the completion of corrective action before recognizing restored eligibility.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa confirms that neglect of obligatory acts manifests sequentially as spiritual disarray. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that misalignment propagates outward unless halted by intentional rectification. Responsibility is proportional to capacity retained; thus, correction restores rather than punishes. The non-punitive reality rule ensures all enforcement serves awakening, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Ritual Rectification Sequence: Offer two ahutis with 'kāmāvakīrṇa' to purify causal disruption.
Assumption Protocol: Agent must verbally acknowledge the omission and declare intent to resume dharmic observance.
Capacity Restoration Module: Reintroduce phased obligations to ensure sustainable compliance.
Integrity Reintegration Process: Confirm alignment through witness attestation and community acknowledgment.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is executed as Source-Law. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator. All actions align toward restoration, never punishment. Reality responds to sincerity, not coercion.
